entries.source: I'm the hired captain of the Orion. She's a fine vessel, true, but a hired captain can love his ship only as much as a paid bride can love her betrothed.
entries.target: Hello World from Gubal Library! If you are reading this, injection works -- but this is the built-in sample corpus, not a translation. Load your own to get the real thing.

entries.source: A ship of my own is all I've ever wanted. Was a gil away from buying one when the Calamity struck, but how can I complain when so many lost so much more?
